english: Then this is your shift: today’s chair, your next customer, and how your week is going. We remember your choice.
translation: Nato vidiš svojo izmeno: današnji stol, naslednjo stranko in kako poteka tvoj teden. Tvojo izbiro si zapomnimo.

english: Holiday, sick days and contract hours are managed by the shop under
translation: Dopust, bolniško in pogodbene ure ureja salon pod

english: Deposits, card or pay-at-salon, weekly payouts.
translation: Predplačila, kartica ali plačilo v salonu, tedenska izplačila.

english: Pay online or at the salon. Reminders and directions included.
translation: Plačaj spletno ali v salonu. Opomniki in navodila za pot so vključeni.

english: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay — or simply pay at the salon.
translation: Kartica, Apple Pay, Google Pay – ali preprosto plačilo v salonu.

english: Patch tests, consent and allergy notes handled before you arrive.
translation: Alergijski testi, soglasja in opombe o alergijah so urejeni, preden prideš.

english: Calendar, payments, team rota, stock and loyalty — one app, no setup fee.
translation: Koledar, plačila, urnik ekipe, zaloga in zvestoba – ena aplikacija, brez stroška vzpostavitve.

english: Uses your taste profile (consent — GDPR Art. 22 explainable)
translation: Uporabi tvoj profil okusa (soglasje – razložljivo po 22. členu GDPR)

english: Rest is paid at the shop

ai_review_note: pm_sepa_mandate: garbled verb 'poberno' (wrong person, non-word) in SEPA mandate; fixed to 'izterja' and 'pooblaščaš'.

english: This card number does not check out — please re-check it.
translation: Ta številka kartice ni veljavna – preveri jo še enkrat.

english: By confirming you authorize StyleNow Demo to collect this amount by SEPA direct debit (demo mandate).
translation: S potrditvijo pooblaščaš StyleNow Demo, da ta znesek izterja z direktno bremenitvijo SEPA (demo pooblastilo).
ai_review_note: pm_sepa_mandate: garbled verb 'poberno' (wrong person, non-word) in SEPA mandate; fixed to 'izterja' and 'pooblaščaš'.

english: Demo checkout — no real charge is made and nothing you type leaves your browser. Only a masked label like “Visa ····4242” is kept.
translation: Demo blagajna – nič se ne zaračuna in nič, kar vneseš, ne zapusti tvojega brskalnika. Shrani se le skrita oznaka, npr. »Visa ····4242«.

english: Your whole configuration — team, hours, menu, rules, photos, billing, customer notes — as one JSON file you own. Download it before big changes; restore it if anything goes wrong.
translation: Vsa tvoja konfiguracija – ekipa, ure, ponudba, pravila, fotografije, obračun, opombe o strankah – kot ena datoteka JSON, ki je tvoja. Prenesi jo pred večjimi spremembami; obnovi jo, če gre kaj narobe.

english: Tap an appointment to reschedule it, message the customer, or settle it.
translation: Dotakni se termina, da ga prestaviš, pišeš stranki ali ga poravnaš.

english: Pick a range — the chart shows the trend, the panels split it by service, team member and payment method.
translation: Izberi obdobje – graf kaže trend, plošče pa ga razdelijo po storitvi, članu ekipe in načinu plačila.

english: Gift cards sold show their outstanding balance — money received for work not yet delivered.
translation: Prodane darilne kartice kažejo neporabljeno stanje – denar, prejet za še neopravljeno delo.

english: The note field is yours alone — customers never see it.
translation: Polje za opombe je samo tvoje – stranke ga nikoli ne vidijo.

english: Open a row to jump straight into that customer’s message thread.
translation: Odpri vrstico in skoči naravnost v pogovor s to stranko.

english: Every customer conversation for this shop, in one place.
translation: Vsi pogovori s strankami tega salona na enem mestu.

english: “Can I move my appointment?” usually answers itself — customers can move bookings from their side.
translation: »Lahko prestavim termin?« se običajno reši samo – stranke lahko rezervacije prestavijo same.

english: Roles, branches and weekly hours — the roster here is exactly what customers can book.
translation: Vloge, podružnice in tedenske ure – urnik tukaj je natanko to, kar stranke lahko rezervirajo.

english: Removing someone who still has booked customers opens a resolver first — nobody gets stranded.
translation: Odstranitev osebe, ki ima še rezervirane stranke, najprej odpre reševalnika – nihče ne ostane na cedilu.

english: Approving leave lists every booked visit inside it, each one a tap to reassign or refund.
translation: Odobritev dopusta našteje vse rezervirane obiske v njem, vsakega lahko z dotikom dodeliš drugemu ali povrneš.

english: Billing details feed every receipt and e-invoice the shop issues.
translation: Podatki za obračun se vpišejo na vsak račun in e-račun, ki ga salon izda.

english: Redeem at checkout — enter the code in the voucher field
translation: Unovči pri plačilu – vnesi kodo v polje za kupon

english: Redeem it at checkout on StyleNow — enter the code in the voucher field when booking at {shop}.
translation: Unovči jo pri plačilu na StyleNow – vnesi kodo v polje za kupon, ko rezerviraš v {shop}.

english: This gift card has been fully used.
translation: Ta darilna kartica je popolnoma porabljena.

english: Bought on this device. The recipient just needs the code — it works in the voucher field at checkout.
translation: Kupljene na tej napravi. Prejemnik potrebuje samo kodo – deluje v polju za kupon pri plačilu.

english: A gift card in two minutes — printable, mailable, redeemable at checkout.
translation: Darilna kartica v dveh minutah – za tiskanje, pošiljanje in unovčenje pri plačilu.

english: Outstanding balances are money received for services not yet delivered — a liability until redeemed.
translation: Neporabljeno stanje je denar, prejet za še neopravljene storitve – obveznost do unovčenja.

english: {have} of {need} stamps — a full card makes the next visit free
translation: {have} od {need} žigov – polna kartica pomeni brezplačen naslednji obisk
Kartica z žigi: vsak {n}. obisk brezplačen
Kartica z žigi (vsak N-ti obisk brezplačen)

english: Your loyalty program, funded by you: {n} completed visits within six months and the next one is free. Stamps and rewards are counted from real bookings — nothing to stamp by hand, nothing to forge.
translation: Tvoj program zvestobe, ki ga financiraš ti: {n} opravljenih obiskov v šestih mesecih in naslednji je brezplačen. Žigi in nagrade se štejejo iz pravih rezervacij – nič ročnega žigosanja, nič ponarejanja.

english: A discount that only applies in your two emptiest day-parts of the last 30 days. Those times carry a badge, so customers see why they’re cheaper.
translation: Popust, ki velja samo v tvojih dveh najbolj praznih delih dneva zadnjih 30 dni. Ti termini imajo značko, zato stranke vidijo, zakaj so cenejši.
{shop} ti je poslal kupon opravičila v vrednosti 5 €

english: Your data lives in this browser. Take it with you, or blank the personal parts in place.
translation: Tvoji podatki so v tem brskalniku. Vzemi jih s seboj ali pa osebne dele izbriši na mestu.

english: Blanks your name, phone, notes, memos and message texts everywhere. Amounts and dates stay, so the salons’ books still add up. Cannot be undone.
translation: Povsod izbriše tvoje ime, telefon, opombe, beležke in besedila sporočil. Zneski in datumi ostanejo, da se knjige salonov še vedno ujemajo. Ni mogoče razveljaviti.
brez odpovedi s strani salona v 90 dneh

english: {n}× cancelled, {m}× moved late by the salon (90 days)
translation: {n}× odpovedano, {m}× pozno prestavljeno s strani salona (90 dni)

english: Late cancel or move by the salon? A €5 sorry-voucher is issued automatically.
translation: Salon pozno odpove ali prestavi? Samodejno se izda kupon opravičila v vrednosti 5 €.

english: What the next shift must know…
Completed service revenue per stylist × their percent (set in the team editor). Tips are listed, never commissioned.
translation: Prihodek od opravljenih storitev na frizerja × njegov odstotek (nastavljen v urejevalniku ekipe). Napitnine so navedene, a brez provizije.

english: This service involves colour chemistry and I have no recent patch test here. I understand the salon may do a quick test first or decline the treatment.
translation: Ta storitev vključuje barvno kemijo in tu nimam nedavnega alergijskega testa. Razumem, da lahko salon najprej opravi hiter test ali zavrne storitev.

english: Patch test was done — remember it
translation: Alergijski test je bil opravljen – zapomni si

english: Patch test recorded for this salon (valid 6 months)
translation: Alergijski test zabeležen za ta salon (velja 6 mesecev)

english: No recent patch test on record for this customer
translation: Za to stranko ni zabeleženega nedavnega alergijskega testa

english: N visits of one service for a bundle price, paid up front. Uses are counted from real bookings — a card cannot be over-spent, and a cancellation returns the use automatically.
translation: N obiskov ene storitve po paketni ceni, plačano vnaprej. Uporabe se štejejo iz pravih rezervacij – kartice ni mogoče preseči, odpoved pa uporabo samodejno vrne.

english: {sold} sold · {uses} visits outstanding · {eur} of prepaid work open
translation: {sold} prodanih · {uses} obiskov neizkoriščenih · {eur} predplačanega dela odprtega

english: Pay once, come back on your terms.
translation: Plačaj enkrat, vrni se, kadar ti ustreza.

english: Gift cards in bulk for your team or clients — one order, one invoice, a volume discount from 5 cards (5 %), 10 (10 %) or 20 (15 %). Every code redeems at full face value.
translation: Darilne kartice na debelo za tvojo ekipo ali stranke – eno naročilo, en račun, količinski popust od 5 kartic (5 %), 10 (10 %) ali 20 (15 %). Vsaka koda se unovči po polni vrednosti.

english: Hand one code to each person — every code is an ordinary gift card at full face value, redeemable in the booking checkout.
translation: Vsaki osebi daj eno kodo – vsaka koda je navadna darilna kartica po polni vrednosti, unovčljiva pri rezervaciji.

english: The payment page could not be opened just now. Your seat is still held — try again in a moment.
translation: Plačilne strani zdaj ni bilo mogoče odpreti. Tvoje mesto je še vedno rezervirano – poskusi znova čez trenutek.

english: Let guests settle at the counter — card or cash — instead of paying when they book. A deposit, where one is set, is still taken online: that is what holds the seat.
translation: Gostom omogoči plačilo na pultu – s kartico ali gotovino – namesto ob rezervaciji. Predplačilo, če je določeno, se še vedno plača spletno: to zadrži mesto.

english: Guests may pay at the salon
When would you like to pay?
Nothing is charged now. {amount} is due at the counter — card or cash, whichever suits.
translation: Zdaj se ne zaračuna nič. {amount} je treba plačati na pultu – s kartico ali gotovino, kakor ti ustreza.

english: Signed before the seat is held, for colour and needle work. Leave empty to ask for nothing. The wording is stored with the booking exactly as it stood when it was signed.
translation: Podpisano, preden se mesto zadrži, za barvanje in delo z iglami. Pusti prazno, če ne želiš ničesar zahtevati. Besedilo se shrani z rezervacijo natanko tako, kot je bilo ob podpisu.

english: I confirm I have no known allergy to the products named, and that I understand the result depends on my hair’s condition…
translation: Potrjujem, da nimam znane alergije na navedene izdelke in da razumem, da je rezultat odvisen od stanja mojih las …

english: Type your full name to sign
translation: Za podpis vpiši svoje polno ime

english: The last 90 days, from the reason people gave at the cancel. One is an anecdote; a pattern is a roster decision.
translation: Zadnjih 90 dni, po razlogu, ki so ga ljudje navedli ob odpovedi. En primer je anekdota; vzorec je odločitev o urniku.

english: Customer announced they are about {n} min late
translation: Stranka je sporočila, da zamuja približno {n} min

english: Withdrawn — the salon expects you on time.
Could not tell the salon — the thread is the reliable door.
translation: Salonu ni bilo mogoče sporočiti – zanesljiv način je pogovor.

english: Custom work has no fixed menu price. Describe what you have in mind and the answer lands in your messages — no booking needed first.
translation: Delo po meri nima fiksne cene v ponudbi. Opiši, kaj imaš v mislih, in odgovor pristane v tvojih sporočilih – rezervacija ni potrebna.

english: A flat monthly fee for a standing discount on every visit. Recurring revenue for you, a reason to stop shopping around for them. (Demo: the fee is simulated, no money moves.)
translation: Fiksna mesečna članarina za stalni popust pri vsakem obisku. Ponavljajoč se prihodek zate, razlog za stranke, da ne iščejo drugje. (Demo: članarina je simulirana, denar se ne premika.)

english: Travels with this device, fills itself into every booking, and disappears with “erase my data”.
translation: Potuje s to napravo, se samodejno vpiše v vsako rezervacijo in izgine z »izbriši moje podatke«.
npr. PPD, amoniak – ločeno z vejicami

english: Only promise what the premises actually have — customers plan their trip around this.
translation: Obljubi le tisto, kar prostori res imajo – stranke po tem načrtujejo pot.

english: Customers who saved their birthday get this discount automatically in the two weeks around it — a guaranteed annual visit occasion.
translation: Stranke, ki so shranile rojstni dan, samodejno prejmejo ta popust v dveh tednih okoli njega – zagotovljena letna priložnost za obisk.
Izdan kupon dobre volje v vrednosti 5 €

english: Colour service: first colour visit here? A patch test 48 h ahead is recommended — just message the salon.
translation: Barvalna storitev: prvi obisk za barvanje tukaj? Priporočamo alergijski test 48 ur prej – piši salonu.

english: Sell a gift card at the counter
Gift card created — hand over the code
Share your code. Your friend gets €5 off their first booking over €25 — and the moment it confirms, a €5 gift card lands on your account.
translation: Deli svojo kodo. Prijatelj dobi 5 € popusta pri prvi rezervaciji nad 25 € – in v trenutku potrditve ti na račun pristane darilna kartica za 5 €.

english: This treatment needs a signed consent, and there is only one consent field for the whole party — book each chair separately instead.
translation: Ta storitev zahteva podpisano soglasje, za celotno skupino pa je samo eno polje za soglasje – raje rezerviraj vsak stol posebej.

english: The day’s money in one printable sheet — revenue, VAT, tips, fees, refunds, and the split by payment method. Derived live from the calendar, so it can never disagree with it.
translation: Denar dneva na enem natisljivem listu – prihodek, DDV, napitnine, pristojbine, vračila in razdelitev po načinu plačila. Izpeljano v živo iz koledarja, zato se z njim nikoli ne more razhajati.

english: Derived from the day’s bookings at the moment of opening. Demo report — not a fiscal document (no TSE signature).
translation: Izpeljano iz rezervacij dneva v trenutku odprtja. Demo poročilo – ni fiskalni dokument (brez podpisa TSE).

english: Seat reserved — finish payment to keep it.
translation: Mesto je rezervirano – dokončaj plačilo, da ga obdržiš.

english: That time was just taken. Here are the nearest free alternatives:
translation: Ta termin je bil pravkar zaseden. Tukaj so najbližje proste alternative:

english: ✅ Cancelled in time — {refund} refunded in full.
Surge is capped at +25 % platform-wide and never hits returning customers on repeat services.
translation: Podražitev je na ravni platforme omejena na +25 % in nikoli ne prizadene vračajočih se strank pri ponovljenih storitvah.

english: Payment is settled at the shop — the seat is blocked immediately.
translation: Plačilo se poravna v salonu – mesto je takoj blokirano.

english: Type the name from the signed consent before booking this treatment.
translation: Pred rezervacijo te storitve vpiši ime s podpisanega soglasja.

english: Tip: click a free spot to add an appointment; click a booking to open it — details, phone, move, complete or cancel.
translation: Namig: klikni prosto mesto, da dodaš termin; klikni rezervacijo, da jo odpreš – podrobnosti, telefon, prestavitev, zaključek ali odpoved.

english: Shown to customers on your shop page and in search. PNG/JPG, squared works best.
translation: Prikazan strankam na strani salona in v iskanju. PNG/JPG, najbolje kvadraten.

english: Missing a category? Add your own
Running several salons? Add each location — they appear as one chain with separate calendars.
translation: Vodiš več salonov? Dodaj vsako lokacijo – prikazane bodo kot ena veriga z ločenimi koledarji.

english: Demonstration project — no real payments or appointments.
translation: Demonstracijski projekt – brez pravih plačil ali terminov.

english: Booked as a business? German bookkeeping systems ingest structured e-invoices (E-Rechnung). This downloads the same receipt as machine-readable XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Private customers don’t need this — the receipt above is your document either way.
translation: Rezervirano kot podjetje? Nemški računovodski sistemi sprejemajo strukturirane e-račune (E-Rechnung). Prenos je isti račun v strojno berljivi obliki XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Zasebne stranke tega ne potrebujejo – zgornji račun je v vsakem primeru tvoj dokument.

english: Generated from this booking’s data and validated against the official KoSIT validator (XRechnung 3.0 rules + EN 16931). Demo notice: the salon data itself is demo data.
translation: Ustvarjeno iz podatkov te rezervacije in preverjeno z uradnim validatorjem KoSIT (pravila XRechnung 3.0 + EN 16931). Demo obvestilo: podatki salona so sami demo podatki.

english: They’re on your bookings page — each can be moved or cancelled on its own.
translation: So na strani tvojih rezervacij – vsakega lahko prestaviš ali odpoveš posebej.

english: Future visits are paid at the salon, visit by visit.
translation: Prihodnji obiski se plačajo v salonu, obisk za obiskom.

english: Tip (not part of the service price)
This receipt is issued by the salon. Keep it for expense claims — salons retain their copies for the statutory period.
translation: Ta račun izda salon. Shrani ga za povračilo stroškov – saloni svoje kopije hranijo zakonsko predpisan čas.

english: What your receipts say. The legal name and tax number appear on every customer receipt.
translation: Kaj pišejo tvoji računi. Pravno ime in davčna številka se pojavita na vsakem računu stranke.
Davčna številka ali ID za DDV

english: Small business (§ 19 UStG) — receipts show no VAT, only the exemption note
translation: Mali podjetnik (§ 19 UStG) – računi ne kažejo DDV, samo opombo o oprostitvi

english: That time was just taken — here is what’s still free
translation: Ta termin je bil pravkar zaseden – tukaj je, kar je še prosto

english: These customers are already booked into this period. Hand each visit to a free colleague, or cancel it with a full refund.
translation: Te stranke so v tem obdobju že rezervirane. Vsak obisk predaj prostemu kolegu ali ga odpovej s polnim vračilom.

english: Moved to {name} — the customer has been notified
That colleague just got booked — list refreshed
translation: Ta kolega je bil pravkar rezerviran – seznam osvežen

english: The shop is calling it off, so the customer pays nothing and gets everything back.
translation: Salon ga odpoveduje, zato stranka ne plača nič in dobi vse nazaj.

english: No messages with this customer yet. Say hello — a short note before an appointment is the cheapest way to stop a no-show.
translation: Še ni sporočil s to stranko. Reci zdravo – kratko sporočilo pred terminom je najcenejši način, da preprečiš izostanek.

english: Replies are public on your shop page. Future customers read how you handle a bad day at least as closely as they read the rating.
translation: Odgovori so javni na strani tvojega salona. Prihodnje stranke berejo, kako ravnaš ob slabem dnevu, vsaj tako pozorno kot oceno.

english: That time has just been taken
translation: Ta termin je bil pravkar zaseden

english: An offer shows on the customer’s bookings page for 30 minutes with that exact time. It doesn’t hold the seat — first come stays first served.
translation: Ponudba se prikaže na strani rezervacij stranke 30 minut z natanko tem časom. Mesta ne zadrži – kdor pride prvi, je prvi na vrsti.

english: People who asked to be told when a day frees up. When a cancellation opens a slot, they are the first call to make.
translation: Ljudje, ki so prosili, da jih obvestimo, ko se sprosti dan. Ko odpoved sprosti termin, so prvi na vrsti za klic.

english: Click a day to book time off for that person; click an existing absence to remove it. Bars show how full a working day already is.
translation: Klikni dan, da rezerviraš prosto za to osebo; klikni obstoječo odsotnost, da jo odstraniš. Vrstice kažejo, kako poln je že delovni dan.

english: An absence removes that person’s hours from the calendar, so no customer can book them while away.
translation: Odsotnost odstrani ure te osebe iz koledarja, zato je nobena stranka ne more rezervirati, medtem ko je odsotna.

english: Anything the shop should know? (allergies, wishes…)
No customers yet — they appear here as soon as someone books.
translation: Še ni strank – pojavijo se tukaj, takoj ko nekdo rezervira.

english: People are matched by phone number when they gave one, so the same customer stays one record across their phone, their laptop and the front desk. Private notes are yours alone — customers never see them.
translation: Ljudje se povežejo po telefonski številki, če so jo navedli, zato ista stranka ostane en zapis na telefonu, prenosniku in recepciji. Zasebne opombe so samo tvoje – stranke jih nikoli ne vidijo.

english: Shuts the whole shop — public holidays, renovation, the summer break. Nobody can be booked on these days, without touching anyone’s roster.
translation: Zapre celoten salon – prazniki, prenova, poletni odmor. V teh dneh nihče ne more rezervirati, brez posega v urnik kogarkoli.

english: The rest is cut into start times on the shop’s slot grid, and each candidate must fit the whole service plus the before/after buffers.
translation: Ostanek se razreže na začetne čase po mreži terminov salona in vsak kandidat mora zajeti celotno storitev ter premore pred/po.
ai_review_note: hr_how_4: 'medpomnilnike' is a computing buffer term; replaced with 'premore'.

english: At checkout the seat is held for 8 minutes and the database has the last word — a seat can only ever belong to one booking.
translation: Pri plačilu je mesto zadržano 8 minut in zadnjo besedo ima podatkovna baza – mesto lahko vedno pripada samo eni rezervaciji.

english: {name} still has upcoming appointments — reassign or cancel them below first.
translation: {name} ima še prihajajoče termine – najprej jih spodaj dodeli drugim ali odpovej.

english: Demo environment — bookings are simulated, no real payments.
translation: Demo okolje – rezervacije so simulirane, brez pravih plačil.

english: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (required)
translation: Sprejemam pogoje uporabe in politiko zasebnosti (obvezno)

english: Demo session — real OAuth activates once the provider is enabled in Supabase.
translation: Demo seja – pravi OAuth se aktivira, ko je ponudnik omogočen v Supabase.

english: Almost there — confirm the link we just emailed you, then sign in.
translation: Skoraj končano – potrdi povezavo, ki smo ti jo poslali po e-pošti, nato se prijavi.

english: Everything stored about you — GDPR Art. 20.
translation: Vse, kar je shranjeno o tebi – 20. člen GDPR.

english: Really delete your account and profile? Bookings history in shops stays for legal retention.
translation: Res želiš izbrisati račun in profil? Zgodovina rezervacij v salonih ostane zaradi zakonske hrambe.

english: This signs you out everywhere and removes your profile. It cannot be undone.
translation: S tem te povsod odjavimo in odstranimo tvoj profil. Tega ni mogoče razveljaviti.

english: 🗑 Your profile, preferences and favourites are deleted.
translation: 🗑 Tvoj profil, nastavitve in priljubljeni so izbrisani.

english: 🔒 Past receipts stay with the salons — German law requires them to keep invoices for the statutory retention period.
translation: 🔒 Pretekli računi ostanejo pri salonih – nemška zakonodaja od njih zahteva hrambo računov v zakonsko predpisanem roku.

english: 📅 Upcoming appointments are NOT cancelled. Cancel them first if you do not want to go.
translation: 📅 Prihajajoči termini NISO odpovedani. Najprej jih odpovej, če ne želiš iti.

english: 📦 Download your data first — after this it is gone.
translation: 📦 Najprej prenesi svoje podatke – po tem jih ni več.
